### Added
- `components.<name>.enabled` on `agent-platform-connectivity`, the same key path the meta chart reads. The meta chart forwards the component roster, stripped to enablement, into the values of that release, so the wiring the chart renders for a component agrees with whether the component has a release. Set it directly only when installing `agent-platform-connectivity` on its own.
- `kyvernoPolicies.enabled` (default `true`) in both charts. Set it to `false` on a cluster that has no Kyverno: the connectivity chart then renders none of its `kyverno.io` objects (the two kagent declarative-agent ClusterPolicies, the kagent seccomp PolicyException, the agent-sandbox pod-security ClusterPolicy), which otherwise fail the install on an unknown API group. **No installation needs to act.** A cluster that enforces restricted PSS through PSA labels instead of Kyverno must set `components.agent-sandbox.enabled: false` as well, or `agentSandbox.podSecurity.enabled: false` where nothing enforces restricted PSS; the render now fails with that instruction instead of shipping a controller Deployment with no securityContext.
### Changed
- The `agentgateway` component tracks the `2.x` chart line, which flattened the upstream keys onto the chart root. The forwarded values block is no longer nested under an `agentgateway` key. **The top-level `agentgateway:` values block otherwise keeps its shape**, so only the toggle moves. `examples/customer-bom.yaml` pins `2.0.0`.
### Removed
- The six per-chart component toggles: `agentgateway.enabled`, `valkey.enabled`, `mcps.enabled`, `kagent.enabled`, `klausGateway.enabled` and `agentSandbox.enabled`. `components.<name>.enabled` is now the only on/off switch for a component, and every installation that sets one of the old keys must move it — see [UPGRADE.md](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/blob/main/UPGRADE.md) for the key-by-key move. `components.<name>.enabled` already existed and already won over the old `enabledFrom` indirection, so a component could be disabled two ways and the two answers could disagree: `components.agentgateway.enabled: false` with `agentgateway.enabled: true` rendered no agentgateway release but still rendered that controller's ListenerSet ClusterRole.
- `components.<name>.enabledFrom`, the indirection from a component entry to a per-chart toggle. There is nothing left to point at.
- Both charts fail the render when one of the removed keys is still set, and name its replacement. Those value blocks accept unknown keys, so an ignored `enabled` would silently turn the component off.
- The `mcps:` values block. It only ever held the toggle; the chart's values keep living under `agent-platform-mcps:`.
